protocol_gaps: No paper-used WebVid sample or shard manifest is released.
The official shard pattern is a placeholder and does not identify the actual 10000-step sample stream.
No dependency lock, container or Accelerate configuration was released.
The data loader depends on an unpinned video2dataset implementation.
The README links InternVideo2-CLIP-1B-224p-f8, while the code requires the distinct InternVideo2 Stage2 1B f4 checkpoint.
The default process partition makes the released command effectively an eight-process protocol despite the paper stating six to eight GPUs.
start_conditions: Obtain a legally usable raw-video and caption corpus with retained source, license and media hashes.
Declare and freeze a deterministic WebDataset shard and sample manifest; do not call it exact paper data unless the authors' manifest is recovered.
Obtain authorized access to the exact f4 InternVideo2 Stage2 checkpoint and record its revision and hash.
Freeze the training environment and the video2dataset implementation.
Pass one-batch data decode, HPS and InternVideo reward, forward/backward, optimizer-step and checkpoint-resume smokes on the release worktree.
